description: This file implements the FontFactory class, which provides methods for resolving, registering, caching, and retrieving font sources and resolver information within the PDFsharp library. It handles font resolution logic, including fallbacks and custom font resolvers, and manages internal font caches.

classes.name: FontFactory
classes.description: A static class providing functionalities for font resolution, registration, and cache management within PDFsharp.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves a font face to a font resolver info, possibly using custom or platform resolvers, with fallback options.

methods.name: RegisterResolverResult
methods.description: Registers font resolver info and font source for a custom font resolver, updating internal caches.

methods.name: GetFontSourceByFontName
methods.description: Retrieves a font source by its face name.

methods.name: GetFontSourceByTypefaceKey
methods.description: Retrieves a font source by its typeface key.

methods.name: TryGetFontSourceByKey
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a font source by its numeric key.

methods.name: HasFontSources
methods.description: Indicates if any font sources are currently cached.

methods.name: TryGetFontResolverInfoByTypefaceKey
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve font resolver info by typeface key.

methods.name: TryGetFontSourceByTypefaceKey
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve font source by typeface key.

methods.name: CacheFontResolverInfo
methods.description: Caches font resolver info with given typeface key.

methods.name: CacheFontSource
methods.description: Caches a font source, ensuring it is stored under both its key and font name.

methods.name: CacheNewFontSource
methods.description: Caches a new font source with a specified typeface key, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: CacheExistingFontSourceWithNewTypefaceKey
methods.description: Adds an existing font source under a new typeface key.

methods.name: CheckInvocationOfPlatformFontResolver
methods.description: Ensures font resolver is called within proper context.

methods.name: GetFontCachesState
methods.description: Returns a string representing current state of font caches for debugging.
